rv.q: Michael Griffo's warm, evocative language and the excellent acting in this two-hander make Pen Pals truly special.
Vardalos, especially, made us believe that we’re getting to know a full human being who just happens to express herself through two-dimensional text.
What is not discussed is the volatile world these two lived in.

cn.t: Critics find this epistolary two-hander warm and well-acted, with evocative writing that elevates a familiar premise. The structure proves sweetly predictable yet sturdy, making for an unchallenging but genuinely special theatrical experience.
